headerDisplay: Connects hOn laundry appliances through the current CIAM/PKCE cloud API. This is an unofficial integration.
footerDisplay: For security, credentials are never written to the Homebridge log. Remote start/stop is deliberately not exposed in this first CIAM release.

pollInterval.title: Active Polling Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Refresh interval while at least one laundry cycle is active or its door is locked during startup.

idlePollInterval.title: Idle Polling Interval (seconds)
idlePollInterval.description: Refresh interval while all appliances are idle. Defaults to five minutes to reduce hOn API traffic.

exposePhaseSensors.title: Expose Cycle Phase Sensors
exposePhaseSensors.description: Adds read-only HomeKit sensors for weighing, washing, rinsing, spinning, drying, steam/refresh and cycle completion.

exposeDoorLock.title: Expose Door Lock
exposeDoorLock.description: Adds a linked, read-only HomeKit lock showing whether the appliance door is locked or unlocked.
